limitations: Answer-quality judge scores are estimates on a fixed 10-question supported sample, not human ground truth.
Unsupported queries have refusal labels but no relevant-chunk labels, so retrieval Recall/MRR apply only to supported questions.
Routed latency is a serial composition of measured artifacts; STANDARD uses dense top-10 latency as both probe and full-retrieval proxy.
Cost excludes local embedding, sparse retrieval, reranking compute, judge calls, caching, and infrastructure; it estimates generation token charges only.
The routed policy remains draft and its false-refusal behavior is visible in the supported retrieval metrics.

measurement_contract.answer_quality: cross-provider LLM judge on the same 10 explicit supported questions per pipeline; scores are 1-5 rubric means
measurement_contract.cost: paired heuristic token projection over all supported retrieval questions using exact prompts and the same verified reference answer
measurement_contract.latency: retrieval-only wall-clock measurements including cold start; routed values use documented serial artifact replay
measurement_contract.percentiles: linear interpolation over ordered per-question measurements
measurement_contract.refusal_correctness: routed policy only, across all 30 reviewed unsupported/adversarial questions; fixed pipelines are not applicable
measurement_contract.retrieval_quality: 50 paired reviewed supported questions; all rankings truncated to top 5; MRR is MRR@5
